thread:
maya r.: Heads-up: Product asked for a combined inputs sheet from HW partners + SI partners covering pricing, settlement timing, SKU EOL notice periods, and any co-sell discount windows. Can someone own a concise template we can push to vendors?

leo wang: I can. Quick requirements: per-region SKU price (reserved monthly + spot hourly), expected settlement lag (days until payout when transacted via marketplace), discount tiers (threshold + pct), and any promotional allowances (e.g., X free GPU-hours for joint announcements).

olivia r.: Also add 'notice_period_months' for SKU deprecations and 'ramp_policy' (e.g., limited quota during N weeks of new SKU). These feed our routing logic for model pinning.

maya r.: Good call. Also ask SIs if they offer managed-service uplift fees or referral credits; those change the effective unit economics for Dedicated.

sam cole: vendor ask: do we want absolute settlement fees separated (listing, transaction, settlement) or a single marketplace_take_pct? finance prefers split to reconcile with invoices.

leo wang: split please: listing_pct, txn_pct, settlement_days.

tara g.: For SI partners, include a boolean "co_sell_enabled" and "co_sell_discount_pct" plus any required joint-announce embargo windows.

maya r.: Example tiny CSV in case that's easier to fill for vendors (we'll attach a nicer sheet with comments):
```
region,gpu_family,sku,reserved_usd_per_month,spot_usd_per_hour,spot_eviction_pct_month,notice_period_months,ramp_quota_first_8_weeks,listing_pct,txn_pct,settlement_days,co_sell_enabled,co_sell_discount_pct,promo_free_hours,partial_day_billing
us-east-1,a100-80gb,sku-a100v3,11500,3.2,9,3,200,2.0,0.5,14,true,7,50,pro-rated-hour
us-west-1,h100-80gb,sku-h100x,13500,4.0,15,6,500,1.5,0.6,21,false,0,0,round-up-hour
```

leo wang: Note: for settlement_days some partners use "settles monthly on X day" rather than a fixed number. Ask them to describe both if applicable.

olivia r.: We should also ask for historical monthly spot-price volatility (12 months) or at least p10/p50/p90 spot eviction rates. That helps our cost shock scenarios.

maya r.: Agreed. If they can't share raw logs, an aggregated time series (month, avg_spot_price, eviction_rate_pct, requests_served) is fine.

supply-bot: Reminder: please do not accept any spreadsheets with customer-identifiable columns. Redlines in #vendor-contracts. :lock:

sam cole: Operational nuance: some partners apply promotional free hours at time of invoice settlement as a credit rather than a true free usage. Ask them to label which type.

leo wang: I'll update the template to include promo_credit_type (credit/true-free).

tara g.: SI note: if co-sell is enabled, add column required_marketing_assets (yes/no) and expected lead-response-time for revenue share tracking.

olivia r.: Also ask for any per-tenant isolation guarantees (e.g., vGPU scheduling, hard partitioning). This impacts tail latency and capacity calculations. Add isolation_model column.

maya r.: We also need to capture any restrictions on running custom kernels or privileged containers (some partners restrict that for marketplace SKUs). Add "kernel_restrictions" text field.

leo wang: For cost modeling, we want volume_discount_tiers as a semicolon-delimited list like "threshold1:discount1;threshold2:discount2" to avoid nested structures.

sam cole: Example: "500:0.05;2000:0.12" meaning 5% at 500 GPU-months, 12% at 2000.

maya r.: Timeline: push to vendors today. Ask them to return the sheet + a short bullet answer file for exceptions by Wednesday EOD. We'll ingest Thursday and run sensitivity.

olivia r.: I'll ping SI contacts and vendor A/Cs. cc @legal for redline check before we accept any attachments.

leo wang: One more ask: if partners support spot interruption advance-notify (N minutes) include that number. It lets us route long tails to preemptible-friendly instances. Add "advance_notify_minutes".

maya r.: Perfect. If anyone hears "we can't share eviction logs" flag here. We'll offer anonymized aggregation in exchange.

sam cole: Finance ask: include billing_currency and any FX pass-through or hedging terms. Some global partners bill in local currency which affects effective unit cost.

olivia r.: Added.

leo wang: I'll assemble the updated CSV and a short fill-in FAQ for vendors. Will post to thread with link to the sheet.

maya r.: Thanks. One last piece: marketing wants to schedule a joint announcement slot for any co-sell pilot partners. Tara, can you coordinate potential PR windows?

tara g.: Yep. I'll follow up separately with proposed slots and required asset checklist.

supply-bot: Attached: partner-contacts-v2.csv (internal).

maya r.: Great work team. Once inputs land we'll run three scenarios: conservative (high eviction), base, and promotional (incorporates co-sell credits) and share the top cost sensitivities.

leo wang: Posting updated template now. Will tag vendors and SIs.
